title: BIMCO-ICS Seafarer Report 2026: India Emerges as World's 2nd-Largest Supplier of Seafarers
summary: Contributes 3,11,936 maritime professionals to global shipping, capturing 12.16% global workforce share.

blocks.content: Contributes 3,11,936 maritime professionals to global shipping, capturing 12.16% global workforce share.

items: Global Ranking: India rose to 2nd globally (behind Philippines, ahead of China and Russia).
Officer Share: 140,718 Indian maritime officers account for 13.41% of world's officer workforce.
Workforce Growth: Share grew from 5.2% in 2015 to 12.16% in 2026 under 'Mission 20%' target.
